newPackages.honest: The art is a 3D bake with the storybook finish, NOT the painted style of the 48 roster sheets that main 1ab4d2b shipped: next to the drawn fox, hobbit and fairy the six ghosts read as cute rounded CG figures with a grey contour and grain (proto/style_before_after.png, proto/gamezoom_check_family.png). The look is closer than the first draft's smooth CG, not identical; the painted route needs the user's imagegen (task 'STYLE TARGET AND HONEST LIMIT', open question 6). The four share Bu's rig, face grammar (a large dark eye with a glint, blush and three cheek strokes) and wisp, so the ghosts are each other's cousins: SIX ghosts of one body plan; only size, hue and ONE modelled accessory tell them apart, and the shape space of the rig is crowded (Gnist - Silke IoU .79 / .76 at S / SE, .82 over all eight directions; Pedro - Silke .79 / .74; Pedro - Dyne .77 / .76: every pair is inside the gate by one to three hundredths). The gate numbers move with main: the pack mean was 167.4 px and is 169.8 px (Gnist's margin 2.8 px), and Pedro's palette reads 5.9 against the gate 6 after the finish. Weak: (1) at night the grade pushes every colour towards blue-violet (identification there rests on silhouette and accessory: the graded colour distance of every pair is 2.8-8.6); (2) Gnist's sleepy eyes read 'smug' from some angles; (3) Silke's lantern is a baked yellow cage next to her mitten, a small brass jar at zoom 0.4, and gives no light until GF-play; (4) Dyne's bun reads as a bump on the head from the front; (5) the back rows (N NW NE) are eggs with a wisp, as for Bu; (6) the walk is the ghost glide (5 px bob), not a step; (7) NPC ghosts have NO baked glow (a baked halo is darkened by the night grade): the glow is GF-play (M3). Eleven iterations were looked at (proto/it1_rows.png ... it9_rows.png and the final edit's variant sheets): peach and mango bodies read as skin or biscuit and were dropped, lime read olive on grass, greige read dull, mint for the grandmother read as a frog.
